description:
Tailscale is a WireGuard based mesh VPN, used to connect your computers and other devices together securely without proxies.


All Platforms
- Fixed: A rare connectivity issue that affected dormant connections has been resolved.
Windows
- Fixed: A connectivity issue that occurred when resuming from Modern Standby on devices without Always On or Unattended mode enabled is resolved.
macOS
- Fixed: Error handling has been improved when multiple network extensions are present.
- Fixed: An issue where MagicDNS could select a suffix-scoped DNS resolver during network transitions has been resolved.
- Fixed: A DNS configuration race condition that could occur during network transitions has been resolved.
